Actual Gaussian polyhedral first moment / boundary identity

Source: GaussianCapFirstMoment.lean
Namespace: NegativeVotingPolyhedral

Let gamma be the actual standard Gaussian on the finite real Euclidean space
FSC.Coord d. Let C={x: for every j, <w_j,x> <= b_j}, with a finite index type.
Assume each normal w_j has norm 1 and the supporting hyperplanes are not
coincident: for distinct j,k, w_j=w_k implies b_j!=b_k, and w_j=-w_k implies
b_j!=-b_k. These are the explicit premises of every boundary identity.

The scalar identity is

  integral_C <v,x> dgamma(x)
    = -sum_j phi(b_j) sliceMass(w,b,j) <w_j,v>.

The vector identity is

  integral_C x dgamma(x)
    = -sum_j phi(b_j) sliceMass(w,b,j) w_j.

Here phi is the actual standard normal density. sliceMass is the actual
conditional Gaussian face probability defined in FSC.Support.Definitions:
the Gaussian residual is translated onto <w_j,x>=b_j and tested against all
remaining halfspaces. Singular face laws are retained explicitly.

No positive-cap-mass, moment-integrability, or differentiability hypothesis
is imposed. All required moments and derivatives are derived. The proof:
  * Differentiates the actual translated cap mass using FSC's concrete
    support derivative.
  * Differentiates the exact MGF translation identity already proved in
    GaussianCapCovariance.lean. Its Gaussian quadratic factor has derivative
    zero at the origin.
  * Identifies that derivative with the actual restricted first moment,
    using mathlib's analytic MGF calculus and proved exponential integrability.
  * Commutes inner products and coordinate projections with the actual
    vector integral, using derived Gaussian vector integrability.

Six audited exports
  cap_translation_derivative
  cap_mgf_first_derivative_boundary
  gaussian_cap_first_moment
  gaussian_cap_vector_integrable
  gaussian_cap_vector_first_moment
  gaussian_cap_coordinate_first_moment

Attribution
  This is a concrete integration proof of a standard Gaussian boundary
  identity. The support derivative is from Abhijeet Mulgund's MIT-licensed
  FSC source at the commit recorded in PROVENANCE.txt. The MGF calculus is
  mathlib, including Remy Degenne's Apache-2.0 MGFAnalytic module. It is not
  a claim of a new integration-by-parts theorem or a complete main proof.

Verification
  lake build GaussianCapFirstMoment
  lake env lean GaussianCapFirstMomentAudit.lean
  python3 verify_first_moment.py --lake /absolute/path/to/lake

The verifier preserves the frozen Boundary/Covariance source and receipts.
